primary_hypothesis.name: PRE_IMPACT_GOLD_PLUS_PYRAMID_MATERIAL
primary_hypothesis.important_boundary: This gate tests whether a chemical fingerprint compatible with pre-impact Egyptian material exists. It does not assume that a pyramid existed at Kamil or that any detected gold is archaeological.

egyptian_gold_reference_fingerprint.universal_warning: There is no single universal ancient-Egyptian gold composition. Natural source variation, period, workshop practice, recycling, soldering, gilding and corrosion all modify measured chemistry.

natural_alluvial_and_placer_markers.interpretation: PGE inclusions are repeatedly documented in Egyptian alluvial-gold artefacts and can be provenance markers, but their absence in a tiny analysed spot does not exclude Egyptian gold.

observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.pattern: yellow gold alloys can approach 99 wt% Au; whitish electrum alloys can exceed 20 wt% Ag
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.PGE: Ir-Os-Ru-Pt-bearing inclusions reported in some objects

observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.context: Middle Kingdom and New Kingdom jewellery
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.pattern: Ag-rich electrum and variable Au-Ag-Cu base alloys; hard solders produced by adding Cu to the base alloy
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.PGE: Ir-Os-Ru systems and Pt-bearing inclusions documented

observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.context: Tutankhamun gilded wooden shawabtis, object-specific comparator
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.bright_yellow_gilding: about 98.5-99.2 wt% Au with less than 1 wt% Ag and Cu in the reported XRF analyses
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.darker_gilding: Ag can reach about 9 wt% in the reported dark areas

observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.context: modern Egyptian placer-gold comparator, not an archaeological-object range
observed_artefact_ranges_and_patterns.use: terrestrial Egyptian native-gold morphology/chemistry control only

craft_modification_markers.hard_solder: Cu-enriched joining zone relative to the adjacent Au-Ag base alloy
craft_modification_markers.intentional_colour_control: Cu may be deliberately increased to produce a redder gold alloy
craft_modification_markers.gilding: thin Au-Ag-Cu foil/leaf may have corrosion-driven surface chemistry different from bulk composition
craft_modification_markers.electrum: Au-Ag alloy with high Ag; some Egyptian objects approach nearly equal Au and Ag

high_priority: Au-rich inclusion many orders above the white-glass meteoritic mass-mixing expectation
Au-Ag-Cu alloying compatible with Egyptian natural or worked gold
absence of proportional Fe-Ni-Co enrichment expected for projectile metal
worked morphology such as foil, sheet, wire, flattened edge, repeated thickness, seam or solder zone
Cu-enriched join/braze adjacent to a different Au-Ag base alloy
repeat occurrence in spatially organized rather than random droplet morphology

pyramid_material_reference_fingerprint.scope: Primary baseline is Giza/Khufu, with other Old/Middle Kingdom pyramid materials used as controls for variability.

tura_casing_limestone.study_specific_note: A Giza heritage study reports the sampled fine outer casing limestone as effectively 100% calcite; this must not be generalized to every casing block without sampling.

broader_pyramid_controls.pyramidion_materials: Royal pyramidia are known in limestone, granite, basalt and other hard stone. Inscriptions for Sahure and queen Udjebten indicate electrum-covered pyramidia; this demonstrates that PYRAMID_STRUCTURE_PLUS_AU_AG_METAL is historically possible, but it does not prove gilding for Khufu or any hypothetical Kamil structure.

expected_melt_or_residue_elements_if_pyr.important_thermal_note: Do not require intact calcite or gypsum in high-temperature glass. Carbonates and sulfates can decompose or react; the gate should search for Ca/S/Mg-rich reaction products, silicates and accessory-element patterns as well as surviving mineral inclusions.

white_glass.interpretation: near-pure target sandstone melt with negligible projectile interaction

impactor_gold_background.warning: This number is only an order-of-magnitude mass-mixing prior. Impact fractionation and metal-silicate partitioning make it unsuitable as a hard forensic threshold.

expected: Cu-enriched solder/braze if a join survives
weak or absent Fe-Ni-Co projectile correlation
Ca-S-Mg-rich carbonate/mortar-derived reaction signature and/or Al-K-Na-Ca-Si granite-derived signature
composition inconsistent with nearly pure local quartzarenite alone
CLASS_C-like worked gold candidate physically embedded in CLASS_D-like nonlocal architectural matrix or glass
spatial association reproducible across more than one fragment

sampling_and_analysis_order: 2_WHITE_GLASS__microXRF elemental maps for Au Ag Cu Ni Co Fe Ca S Mg Al K Na Ti Zr Ba Sr
3_CANDIDATE_INCLUSIONS__SEM-EDS plus EPMA/WDS for morphology and major/minor chemistry
4_TRACE_FINGERPRINT__LA-ICP-MS or microPIXE where destructive/minimally destructive permission exists
9_BLIND_CLASSIFICATION__sample labels hidden until chemical classes are assigned

reverse_pass.result: Assume gold and/or architectural material predated the Kamil event; derive required surviving chemical and morphological traces.
Use white glass as the cleanest target-dominated product and dark glass as the projectile-contamination control.
Separate worked Egyptian-style Au-Ag-Cu from natural Egyptian placer gold using morphology, solder chemistry and spatial organization.
Separate pyramid-derived Ca-S-Mg / aluminosilicate signatures from ordinary Kamil quartzarenite and local sediment contamination.
Promote only coupled anomalies that survive both the gold-origin and material-origin discriminators.
A chemical match is not a pyramid identity. Independent archaeology and context remain mandatory.

next_gate.name: KAMIL_EXISTING_SAMPLE_CHEMISTRY_TABLE_EXTRACTION_V2
tasks: Extract sample-by-sample major/trace chemistry for published Kamil white glass, dark glass, unshocked target and aeolian sand.
Search museum and laboratory holdings for retained Kamil white-glass specimens suitable for non-destructive microCT/microXRF.
Build an authenticated Egyptian gold reference matrix by period and object type, preserving Au-Ag-Cu and PGE/solder features.
Build a Giza/Old-Kingdom construction-material reference matrix for limestone, mortar, granite and known pyramidia.
Run blind nearest-signature and mixture-model controls before opening any archaeological interpretation.
